spots.text: INK RECEIVED: enough for every book. INK USED: exactly that much, and not one drop over. There is no such thing as a spare letter.

secrets.name: The Ink Room
secrets.text: Under the biggest press, down through a hatch between its legs: the room where the ink is kept. It smells of iron and night. The vats are full, and they are always full.

meta.label: The Press Hall
meta.blurb: The presses are running. Nobody is feeding them and nobody is reading what they print, and the paper has been coming out for long enough to fill the aisles.
